answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks sybil flooding: each identity needs a distinct earned history, not a free signup. A newcomer locks 30 POA and must finish 12 verifiable tasks before it unlocks; a falcon checker samples traces and rejects copies. Making 100 fakes needs 100 histories and 3,000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays 30 POA once and earns it back, like nectar from real foraging. In an ocean of past work, clones cost too much, so honest rewards stay undiluted.
